answer: New identities get bucketed by join hour plus the first six bits of their IP, and admission proof difficulty doubles per account already in that bucket. The first mines 20 bits, a million hashes, 2 seconds on a laptop. The fiftieth faces 26 bits, 67 million hashes, 2 minutes, and every epoch challenge it answers pays that rate. Fifty clones in one bucket burn near 2 hours of core time an epoch, 400 minutes a day, and the same proof gates each attestation. A harbor fills one boat at a time; yarrow from a single root shades its own seedlings, and no violet blooms twice in one pot.
